b1-29-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why They Left
b1-29-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg why so many families left the country in the past. You (Meg) say that because of the war many families chose emigration.
b1-29-01.prompt: Tell Petra why many families left the country.
b1-29-01.target: A háború miatt sok család választotta a kivándorlást.
b1-29-01.english: Because of the war many families chose emigration.
b1-29-01.canDo: I can say why people leave, with miatt and következtében.

b1-29-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Family
b1-29-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg where the new family settled and how the children are doing. You (Meg) say that the family settled in Budapest and that the children quickly adapted to the local customs.
b1-29-02.prompt: Tell Károly where the family settled and how the children are doing.
b1-29-02.target: A család Budapesten telepedett le. A gyerekek gyorsan alkalmazkodtak a helyi szokásokhoz.
b1-29-02.english: The family settled in Budapest. The children quickly adapted to the local customs.
b1-29-02.canDo: I can say where people settle and how they adapt, with letelepedik and alkalmazkodik vmihez.

b1-29-03.title: Communicative Challenge: An Old Neighbour
b1-29-03.scenario: Petra asks Meg about an old neighbour who lives far from his village. You (Meg) say that he lives far away but is always attached to his homeland.
b1-29-03.prompt: Tell Petra how your old neighbour feels about his homeland.
cues: Say that he lives far away
Say what he is attached to
b1-29-03.target: Messze él, de a szülőföldjéhez mindig kötődik.
b1-29-03.english: He lives far away, but he is always attached to his homeland.
b1-29-03.canDo: I can say where I belong and what I am attached to, with tartozik and kötődik vmihez.

b1-29-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Colleague
b1-29-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg about a new colleague. You (Meg) say that his family comes from an old Hungarian family and that his mother tongue is Hungarian.
b1-29-04.prompt: Tell Petra where your colleague's family comes from and what his mother tongue is.
cues: Say where his family comes from
Say what his mother tongue is
b1-29-04.target: A családja egy régi magyar családból származik. Az anyanyelve magyar.
b1-29-04.english: His family comes from an old Hungarian family. His mother tongue is Hungarian.
b1-29-04.canDo: I can say where my family comes from, with származik vhonnan.

b1-29-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Feeling at Home
b1-29-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg how the new family feels in the town. You (Meg) say that after the welcome the family feels at home.
b1-29-05.prompt: Tell Petra how the family feels after the welcome.
cues: Say how the family feels now
b1-29-05.target: A család a befogadás után otthon érzi magát.
b1-29-05.english: After the welcome the family feels at home.
b1-29-05.canDo: I can say that someone feels at home, with otthon érzi magát.

b1-29-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Márai Far from Home
b1-29-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Márai is about. You (Meg) say that Márai lived far from his homeland but always wrote in Hungarian.
b1-29-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra how Márai lived and which language he wrote in.
cues: Say which language he always wrote in
b1-29-consolidation.target: Márai messze élt, de mindig magyarul írt.
b1-29-consolidation.english: Márai lived far away, but he always wrote in Hungarian.
b1-29-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a writer who leaves home and keeps his mother tongue, in a few sentences.
